{"id":1926900599,"question_id":4226,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months","timestamp":1771729095,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1926900599/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check Digitorial Permutation","memory":"8.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isDigitorialPermutation(int n) {\n        vector<int>fact(10 , 1);\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<=9 ; i++){\n            fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i;\n        }\n\n        vector<int>digits(10 , 0);\n        int temp = n;\n        while(temp > 0){\n            int digit = temp % 10;\n            digits[digit]++;\n            temp /= 10;\n        }\n\n        int sum = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<=9 ; i++){\n            sum += (digits[i] * fact[i]);\n        }\n\n        vector<int>countdigitsofsum(10 , 0);\n        temp = sum;\n        while(temp > 0){\n            int digit = temp % 10;\n            countdigitsofsum[digit]++;\n            temp /= 10;\n        }\n\n        if(countdigitsofsum != digits) return false;\n\n        int len1 = 0 , len2 = 0;\n        temp = n;\n        while(temp > 0){\n            len1++;\n            temp /= 10;\n        }\n        temp = sum;\n        while(temp > 0){\n            len2++;\n            temp /= 10;\n        }\n\n        if(len2 < len1) return false;\n        return true;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-digitorial-permutation","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1730}
